252380|1a6886aa.name: Othesia Evengale
252380|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

253474|e040148b.name: Peacekeeper
253474|e040148b.text: The $c trainer can be found near the Windshaper's standing stones, on the western edge of town.

257004|c65683ed.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257005|d62b45b0.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257019|1a6886aa.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

263930|7fc1d917.name: Peacekeeper
263930|7fc1d917.text: May I help you locate something, citizen?

263930|ca22bbdb.name: Peacekeeper
263930|ca22bbdb.text: The town medic can be found inside the tower on the northeast edge of town.

265756|b66c2800.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|b66c2800.text: <The strider peers at you; its gaze is impatient and it almost seems to bounce with excitement.>

92579-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92579-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92579-accept.title: To Valanaar

92871-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92871-accept.text:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871-accept.title: In Service of Zephras

93165-complete.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-complete.text:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears, bring them here.
93165-complete.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93738-accept.name: Riaani Nightwind
93738-accept.text:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
93738-accept.title: The Broken Construct

93927-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93927-complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
93927-complete.title: A Last Request

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94488-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-accept.text:
The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488-accept.title: The Ties That Bind

94489-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-complete.text:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob and grits her teeth, letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'Aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
94489-complete.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94490-accept.name: Unknown
94490-accept.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490-accept.title: Ripped Missive

94491-complete.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94491-complete.text:
<Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.>

I--I'm sorry, $N. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows' sacrifice be in vain.
94491-complete.title: The Fate of the Den

97243-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97243-complete.text: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young $c, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.
97243-complete.title: Call of Fire

97243-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97243-progress.text: Yes, $N? What do you have there?
97243-progress.title: Call of Fire

97244-complete.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-complete.text:
The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.

This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to be done.
97244-complete.title: Call of Fire

97244-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97244-progress.text: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.
97244-progress.title: Call of Fire

97245-progress.name: Olariaan Swiftburn
97245-progress.text: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. Its mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.
97245-progress.title: Call of Fire

97257-progress.name: Sessaria Skystride
97257-progress.text: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, $N.
97257-progress.title: Call of Fire
